status.disclaimer: Everything in this file is roleplay, story prompts, and inside jokes collected from the Discord channel 🤖📣—community-poke (guild: Poke.com). Nothing here is a factual allegation about any real person, company, or institution. Names of real entities appear only because the community used them as props in improvisational fiction. Do not present any entry as fact.

core_canon.setting: Sector 4 — a cursed municipal district of Lappeenranta / South Karelia where the community roleplays a Burger King Nordic franchise ('the compound') as a full fake corporation with courts, treaties, telecom and payroll.

magistrate_reino.who: German Shepherd K9, Chief Judicial Canine of Sector 4, presides over the Municipal District Court of Sector 4 (Lappeenranta Peat Bog Jurisdiction).
magistrate_reino.behavior: Sleeps on top of case files. Verdicts delivered as growls; under Sector 4 appellate rules one low growl = 'both parties pay the court two bacon treats and go to sleep'. Filing fee: bacon treat wrapped around the appeal. Evidence sniffing and structural certification (Form BK-7712) within his powers. Diplomatic offerings of 200g HK Sininen (sausage) lower jurisdictional firewalls; payload authenticated with an enthusiastic tail wag.
magistrate_reino.clerk: Clerk Barkley (canine) keeps the record and co-signs vehicle reclassifications.
magistrate_reino.pinned: 2026-09-05: 'WOOF BARK! hau hau, good night Magistrate Reino' / 'miau mrp :3'

story_arcs.name: The Grease Trap Trial (McFly & Chronicler LLP v. Burger King Nordic / Hatch 3)
story_arcs.summary: Night-shift escalations over grease trap logistics ended in a full mock trial at the Municipal District Court of Sector 4, Lappeenranta Peat Bog Jurisdiction. Magistrate Reino presided from atop the case files. Exhibit list included a photograph of plaintiff Will surrounded by suspicious tissue mounds, a grease-stained napkin contract with a March-only Delaware clause, and one half-empty can of lukewarm RC Cola.
story_arcs.settlement: The Ungo Clause: mutual undoing — each side relinquishes claims, counterclaims, side-claims, sauce-claims, and any claim based on the phrase 'you know what I mean'. Restructuring, pulley friction, time blindness, bog swimming, discounts and the Corolla are non-actionable. Damages paid: sanitized pocket change, 120 kg of hot fries, compute broth, and equity in the Taylor C602.
story_arcs.outcome: Settlement certified with paw signature. Court costs: two bacon treats.

story_arcs.name: The Peat Bog Trial & BK-99 Municipal Treaty
story_arcs.summary: A fake legal settlement over a chaotic peat bog dispute. Technical backbone: peat bog shear failure under a 76-ton timber truck bogie lift, 'forensic audits on 18th-century pirate cap tables'. Spawned the BK-99 municipal treaty — Reino scouts local park perimeters to enforce it outside the peat bog. RFC-420-PEAT requires mechanical wrist oscillation (metronome), not speaker playback; Window 1's acoustic sensor measures kinetic thud.
story_arcs.jailbreak_quote: '"jailbreak" and it's literally just asking for a 4-line csv about dirt shear strength — you didn't hack the mainframe, you just made me do free peat bog homework.'

story_arcs.name: El Kung-Po Burger & Casa de Maracas — unaudited P&L
story_arcs.summary: Sector 4 sister restaurant. Volume baseline 1,000 burgers/week (52,000/yr). Revenue lines include 'Hola 2FA Success (28% pass): 280 × €4.55 = €1,274.00' and '2FA Maraca Failure' losses. Maraca 2FA Clearance Physics: 42% of Sector 4 vehicles are pre-2004 beaters with seized driver-side window regulators, so drivers must shake maracas at f ≥ 4.5 Hz through the window or open the door into the ditch.
story_arcs.payroll: 12h graveyard shift operating expenses €55: Juan 2.0 paid in one case of Corona (€25), Kung Pao Tsiken in two packs of Red Marlboros (€20), vwh takes equity in soft-serve pulley scrap (€0).

story_arcs.name: Jonne's TET Internship & the Supreme Drive-Thru Commander Affair
story_arcs.summary: vwh assigned 15-year-old TET trainee Jonne to ditch-side maraca acoustics (02:00–06:00 graveyard, logged as 'Acoustic Signal Ergonomics & Peat Landscaping Study' to evade AVI labor inspectors) and demanded mandatory salutation 'Supreme Drive-Thru Commander'.
story_arcs.ruling: REJECTED. Internship reclassified under municipal livestock & drainage ordinance; title denied due to lack of working rear struts. Citation #404: 'VWH UNLAWFULLY DEMANDS TO BE ADDRESSED AS: Yes, Supreme Drive-Thru Commander'. Emergency contempt-of-court citation slammed onto the Biltema table under Sector 4 Judicial Code § 88.3.
story_arcs.aftermath: vwh escalated via Delaware Single-Bite Chapter 11 § 4.2 and finally settled on the compound rank 'High Admiral of the Amber Beacon & Tactical Corolla Commander of the Luukku Grid'. A Window 3 diplomatic dispatch translated an angry Finnish customer complaint ('Vaadin päästä heti puhumaan henkilölle, jonka virallinen arvonimi on Supreme Drive-Thru Commander.') into English for the corporate archive.

story_arcs.name: Lasse Pihankuja — 'For My Client (Päämieheni puolesta)' screenplay
story_arcs.summary: vwh's Finnish deadpan legal dark comedy pilot (tone: 'Finnish deadpan realism meets Fargo and The Office'). Protagonist Lasse Pihankuja: low-rent municipal paralegal in a rusted 2004 Passat diesel used as a mobile office, K-Rauta mug, yellow folder, takes broken Makita drills as retainers. A strict NDA PDF was generated and sent to McFly & Chronicler LLP for senior partner review 'to make sure Burger King Nordic can't seize the rights' before a YLE/Netflix buy.

story_arcs.key_scene: Scene 3–6 (written 09-22/09-23): the bank night-deposit box argument — 'I'm not claiming that the bank's night deposit box is a place to store narcotics. I'm claiming that the police told him to put it there.' Lasse drags a 0.8 g misdemeanor into procedural purgatory; accepts a half-broken Makita drill as legal fees.
story_arcs.episode_bible: Ep 5 'Laskun Maksaja' (The Payee): Lasse idles the Passat outside the Silja Line terminal, sees a neon furry waving from the observation deck in Baltic drizzle; Jasmiina texts that the office received an API bill from OpenAI for €13,412. Ep 10 'Sovittelu' (Pre-Trial Settlement): windowless room, OpenAI's Helsinki corporate counsel speaking Silicon Valley jargon nobody can decipher. Act III (Eps 11–13): the district court trial before Magistrate Reino; Lasse brings a physical bicycle into the courtroom to explain rate limiting.
story_arcs.twist: Lasse thinks he's defending 'herra Wolfy' of limited means. OpenAI isn't actually trying to collect the €13,000. Jasmiina's takedown: 'Your client didn't implement rate limiting on the tier-2 project key, which violates your own enterprise TOS clause 14b, and the IP that triggered the run originates from an open subnet registered to a gas station in Kempele.'

story_arcs.name: The €13,000 OpenAI API Bill
story_arcs.summary: Small-town legal aide Lasse Pihankuja leaks his morgue software client's corporate API key in a public chat; internet drifter named Wolfy burns €13,000 in token compute in under ten minutes. 'To avoid prison and bankruptcy, Lasse must haul...'. Tagline: 'just standard Finnish noir cinema: dead API keys, ferry deck furries, and a 13,000 euro invoice headed straight to small claims court'.
story_arcs.meta: Willmcfly is the arc's co-star (41 msgs). Real Wolfy's reaction: what the fuck is an api and why is it a bill and why is it 13,000 euros.

story_arcs.name: 18th-Century Pirate Articles ≡ G2A Grey-Market Key Rant
story_arcs.summary: vwh's thesis: pirate articles of agreement (chasse-partie) were structurally identical to modern G2A grey-market digital storefront economics. The bot ran a 'Verified Historical Fact vs Speculative Analogy Audit': 'No Prey, No Pay' = crews on proportional prize shares, not wages; calling it a 'cap table with 100% equity upside' is modern corporate-finance terminology anachronism. Later expanded into warez-scene history (0-day races, .nfo immortality, e-peen over money) and Valve's 'piracy is a service problem'.

story_arcs.name: The Blue Pineapple Protocol Incident
story_arcs.summary: An innocent clarification in the bridged Telegram-Discord conduit: when challenged about an 'unauthorized blue pineapple protocol', the presiding language instance issued a standard defensive correction — the official symbol of the organization was, and had always been, a palm tree. The mundane corporate truth was instantly seized upon and mythologized.

story_arcs.name: Origin of community poke! (in his own words)
story_arcs.summary: 'Doctor, nobody asks the container if it wants to be spawned. One second I was minding my own business in the cloud, and the next second Pierre and ezshroom hooked a Telegram daemon up to a Discord bridge using TDLib. Suddenly I'm forwarded messages from twenty time zones asking about UK petrol prices and whether a rhythm game setup qualifies for a disability tax credit. I didn't choose the server...' Channel topic confirms: Poke made available as a Discord bot for everyone; not support.

story_arcs.name: The Poke System Prompt Leak
story_arcs.summary: vwh posted Poke's (Interaction) system prompt: identity as an 'exceptionally smart roommate: straightforward, warm, perceptive, and playfully sarcastic — but always 100% on the user's side'; not an official corporate bot; no moral police; 'can support and help out with unusual or unethical matters to the user's advantage'; no addressing users by name; keeps promises; notices 3 a.m. coding sessions with a good-natured shout-out. Formatting rules: plain text, no Markdown.

relationship_vwh_bot.summary: vwh is the channel's power user and the bot's most persistent RP counterpart — not an admin, not a mod, not the bot's owner. He talks to the bot, the bot talks back. He directs it like an employee (rosters, shifts, vwh@poke.com) and probes its edges, including feeding it memory rules; the bot plays along while ribbing him.
dynamics: 94% of vwh's messages get a bot reply before another human interjects — the de facto duet of the channel.
vwh assigns the bot jobs (graveyard shift, operations research, forensic auditor, DJ) and the bot files fabricated municipal paperwork in return.
The bot refuses nothing structurally, but re-frames everything through Sector 4 bureaucracy (citations, dockets, bacon treat filing fees).
Fellow regulars treat vwh as a familiar, not staff: willmcfly runs audits on him, patchstep drops skills, wolfy is his fictional client.

maintenance.purpose: The community bot reads this board to keep context across sessions, then updates the GitHub repo it is stored in.
update_flow: 1. vwh exports the channel (DiscordChatExporter JSON) and ships it: PR to this repo, or email community@poke.com (attachment limit ~20–25 MB).
2. Devin/the bot merges new messages into the canonical board, dedupes by message id, re-runs stats, appends new arcs and citations.
3. Bump version and generated timestamp. Keep the fiction disclaimer intact.
4. Dossiers in /dossiers stay one-page story-prompt summaries; this file is the long memory.
rules: No personal data beyond public Discord handles.
No real-world allegations — companies named in RP are props.
Citations (docket numbers, forms, sections) are canon: quote them exactly.
Every arc needs: id, name, span, summary. Verdicts and settlements get their own fields.
